**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

Every resumed invocation replaces the wall anchor, while reset discards the prior boundary. After a backward clock adjustment, the terminal `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` can therefore end before an `Invocation` already exported under that root by the same warm plugin instance. Retain a per-execution high-water boundary across resets and clamp terminal root ends to it; mirror this in `ExecutionOtelPlugin` and test the negative-wall-step same-plugin case.
